dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: Aoi skids to the corner, school bag thumping against her side.
She had left home late after redoing the ribbon on her uniform twice, then gone back for the welcome packet she forgot on the table.
Now the station road is crowded with students, office workers, and parents hurrying in every direction.
If I cut through the plaza... maybe I can still make it.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: She takes one step toward the crosswalk, then stops.
Near the bus stop, a little boy stands alone, crying soundlessly, one hand twisted in the strap of a tiny yellow backpack.
People glance at him, hesitate, and keep moving.
Are you... lost?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: shy

dialogue.text: M-My grandma was here... and then she wasn't.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: His cheeks are wet. He looks too young to be going anywhere alone.
It's okay. Don't move, all right?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Do you know her phone number?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: No...
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Aoi looks toward the station clock.
First bell is getting closer.
...It's fine.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: We'll find someone to help.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: She leads him carefully to the nearby police box.
The shutter is half-down. A handwritten sign says the officer is out on patrol.
Ah...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: confused

dialogue.text: The boy's lip trembles harder at the sight of it.
I want my grandma...
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: I know.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sad

dialogue.text: Let's stay where she can find you.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Aoi kneels so her eyes are level with his.
What does she look like?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Brown hat. And... and flowers on her bag.
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: Aoi swallows, then raises her voice just enough to be heard over the traffic.
Excuse me!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Has anyone seen an older woman with a brown hat?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: For a moment, nobody answers.
Heat crawls up Aoi's neck. She hates calling attention to herself.
She's looking for this boy.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: Then, from across the plaza, a strained voice cuts through the morning noise.
Haru! Haru!
dialogue.speaker: Grandmother

dialogue.text: An elderly woman hurries toward them, one shoe half-off, a flower-patterned tote clutched in her hand.
Grandma!
dialogue.speaker: Boy

dialogue.text: He runs to her. She drops to her knees and holds him so tightly Aoi has to look away.
Thank you... thank you so much. I only turned for a second.
dialogue.speaker: Grandmother

dialogue.text: I'm glad I found him.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: The grandmother's eyes shine with exhausted relief.
You're in uniform... dear, aren't you late?
dialogue.speaker: Grandmother

dialogue.text: Aoi looks at the station clock again.
The bell time has already passed.
...Yes.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: embarrassed

dialogue.text: The answer lands heavier than she expects.
Her stomach twists. First day. Late. Exactly what she wanted to avoid.
I'm sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Grandmother

dialogue.text: Please don't be.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: shy

dialogue.text: He wasn't alone.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: determined

dialogue.text: The grandmother bows deeply, still holding the boy's hand.
Aoi returns the bow, then breaks into a run again.
Her chest is tight, but not only from rushing now.
When she reaches the school gate, a teacher is already standing there with a clipboard.
You there. First-year? Name?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi Sakamizu.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: anxious

dialogue.text: Reason for being late?
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Aoi's fingers curl around her bag strap.
For a second, she thinks about saying something easier. Train delay. Overslept. Anything smaller.
I stopped to help a lost child near the station.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: embarrassed

dialogue.text: The teacher blinks, then studies her face.
...I see. Go on in. Next time, report to the office after.
dialogue.speaker: Teacher

dialogue.text: Yes, sir.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: embarrassed

dialogue.text: She hurries past him, breathless.
Embarrassment still burns in her cheeks.
But under it, quiet and steady, something warmer remains.
It was okay.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: smile

dialogue.text: And for the first time that morning, she believes it.
